newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Cbank sets one week repo at maximum 22 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech Cbank sets one week repo at maximum 22 pct.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) on Friday set a one week American style repo tender with a maximum rate of 22 percent.
In the last one-week repo tender the central bank drained funds at 29 percent.
The CNB said it would accept two bids from participants at a minimum of 100 million crowns until 10.00 a.m. (0800 GMT) in the operation.
The central bank has been holding several tenders on almost a daily basis over the past few weeks in order to drain liquidity from the market and help support the crown.
